_comment: Global default configuration. JSON rather than YAML because the runtime does not require pyyaml.
_status: Reference copy, not an input. `python -m bit_hyrl train` never reads this file: cmd_train builds TrainConfig from the command-line flags, so the flags are the run configuration. The values below mirror the run behind every reported number and are checked against the CLI defaults by scripts/check_package.py, but the authoritative record of that run is the `cfg` block of the shipped checkpoint (results/checkpoints/ppo_final_s0.pt).
